documentation: Waivers for check-model-id-requests.mjs. Each entry names one model id literal in one file that sits in a request position but never becomes a request, and states why. A waiver is not a way to skip the served-model assertion on a real call: when the literal reaches a provider, assert the served id instead (src/integrity/served-model.ts). Entries are matched by file and literal, not by line, so they survive edits; a waiver that matches nothing fails the gate, so the list cannot rot.
